overall_assessment: Modern-format UiT pages (Om emnet / Hva lærer du / Undervisning og pensum / Eksamen, ~2013 onwards) are split well, but arbeidskrav handling and prerequisites are weak. Legacy FS pages (2008-2012, headings Innhold / Læringsutbytte / Undervisningsform / Eksamensform / Pensum) go through the text fallback with only 'Andre år og semester' and 'Kontakt oss' read, so they are either not extracted at all or collapsed into badly merged sections (outcomes + teaching + assessment heading; assessment + reading list).

findings.description: Legacy-format plans with clear Innhold, Læringsutbytte/Mål, Undervisningsform, Eksamensform and Pensum blocks yield no sections at all (4 of 4 such suspects: also SAM-3940, a bare stub). Whole records are lost.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Legacy pages expose no h2 headings the reader recognises (only 'Andre år og semester' and 'Kontakt oss'), and the text fallback does not split on the plain-text label lines (Innhold, Mål, Læringsutbytte, Undervisningsform, Eksamensform, Pensum). Likely the section_* config for uit targets only the new layout.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a legacy line-label splitter for uit (text fallback keyed on line-start labels Innhold, Læringsutbytte, Mål, Undervisningsform, Eksamensform, Vurderingsordning, Arbeidskrav, Pensum) and add the missing labels to R/section_heading_map.R (Mål -> learning_outcomes, Undervisningsform -> teaching_methods, Eksamensform -> assessment, Emnetype/Dato for eksamen -> .drop).

findings.evidence: Mastergradsoppgaven er et selvstendig arbeid med veiledning. Veiledningen inkluderer både sosialantropologi og praktisk pedagogikk.
findings.description: On legacy pages the labels Undervisnings- og eksamensspråk, Undervisningsform and Vurderingsordning (plus arbeidskrav bullets in LRU-1451) are not split, so learning_outcomes swallows the teaching method, language and the heading 'Vurderingsordning'. Likewise course_content ends with the stray heading 'Læringsutbytte' plus its intro sentence. The same happens in EXF-0723 2010 where outcomes include Undervisningsform text.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Only Innhold and Læringsutbytte are recognised in the text fallback; subsequent labels are unmapped and appended to the previous section. Sub-heading Kunnskaper/Ferdigheter handled, but Undervisningsform/Vurderingsordning not.
findings.suggested_fix: Map Undervisningsform -> teaching_methods, Undervisnings- og eksamensspråk -> .drop (or language), Vurderingsordning/Eksamensform -> assessment, and cut course_content before 'Læringsutbytte' at a line start in the legacy splitter.

findings.evidence: Pensumlista er todelt med en oversikt over teori- og didaktikkpensumet og en oversikt over primærtekstene
findings.description: The Pensum block (10 800 chars in both LRU-1400 plans, 3 300 in LRU-1451) is inside assessment, so reading_list is empty or wrong. In LRU-1400 reading_list instead holds the Innhold text and outcomes heading (wrong content), and teaching_methods is missing. The pre-pass flags 'long' and 'leak->.drop' are real.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Pensum heading not recognised on legacy pages; exam text runs to the end of the page. In LRU-1400 the splitter misaligns Innhold (filed as reading_list) because the first heading it sees is wrongly mapped.
findings.suggested_fix: Same legacy splitter as above: cut at line-start 'Pensum' and map to reading_list; verify that 'Innhold' maps to course_content (not reading_list) on legacy pages.

findings.evidence: I dette området arbeides det med litterær teori med lesing og tolking av skjønnlitteratur og sakprosa
findings.description: The course content (the three subject areas) is filed under reading_list, followed by the heading 'Læringsutbytte' and a fragment of outcomes, so reading_list is polluted and course_content is absent.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Text-fallback section boundary is off by one: content following 'Innhold' is attributed to a later heading.
findings.suggested_fix: Fix the legacy splitter so text between Innhold and Læringsutbytte goes to course_content; add test with LRU-1400.

findings.description: Legacy assessment text contains the 'Dato for eksamen' block (empty exam labels, the 'Eksamensdato er foreløpig...' notice), raw HTML div fragments and trailing 'Undervisning ... Første gang' logistics. This is exam logistics/markup, not assessment.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Unclosed HTML in the source pages leaks into extracted text; no clean-up of this FS boilerplate in .clean_sections().
findings.suggested_fix: In .clean_sections() (or as an anonymizer-independent text cleanup for uit) strip lines matching '^</?div' / 'fsemnetext', the 'Dato for eksamen' block through 'primo november for høstsemesteret.' and the trailing 'Undervisning\s+...' line.

findings.evidence: Jf. opptakskrav og progresjonskrav i studieplanen for grunnskolelærerutdanning for 1.-7. trinn og 5.-10. trinn.
findings.description: A 'Forkunnskapskrav' / 'Forkunnskapskrav, anbefalte forkunnskaper' sub-block inside 'Om emnet' stays in course_content; prerequisites is not extracted (flag leak->prerequisites is real). In LER-1710 the 'Opptakskrav' heading is mapped to .drop, so the real requirement (samisk 2 på videregående) is lost. Note much of this text is admission cross-reference, but recommended prerequisites ('Det anbefales gode forkunnskaper i engelsk') are real.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: 'Forkunnskapskrav' appears as a plain paragraph line inside the Om emnet block (not an h2), so heading detection misses it; 'Opptakskrav' is deliberately mapped to .drop in R/section_heading_map.R.
findings.suggested_fix: Add line-start split for 'Forkunnskapskrav(, anbefalte forkunnskaper)?' inside course_content and map to prerequisites; map 'Opptakskrav' to prerequisites rather than .drop when it holds concrete requirements.

findings.evidence: Følgende arbeidskrav må være godkjent før man kan framstille seg for eksamen:
findings.description: On the 2012-2019 layout the Arbeidskrav list sits under the 'Eksamen' heading and ends up in assessment; coursework_requirements is not emitted at all (LRU-1502 x2, LRU-3640, LER-1152F, LRU-3904). Codebook: arbeidskrav are pass/approve gates and belong in coursework_requirements.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: No sub-heading separates arbeidskrav from Eksamen on these pages (only the 2020s layout has 'Mer info om arbeidskrav'); sectionize() has no line-start rule for 'Arbeidskrav'/'Følgende arbeidskrav ...'.
findings.suggested_fix: In the assessment block split off paragraphs starting 'Følgende arbeidskrav må være ...' (up to 'Eksamen består av'/'Eksamen og vurdering') into coursework_requirements; also treat a standalone line 'Arbeidskrav' as a heading.

findings.evidence: Alt du trenger å vite om før, under og etter eksamen, oppmelding, fravær klage og vitnemål: UiTs samleside om eksamen
findings.description: In the 2020s layout the 'Eksamener / Obligatoriske arbeidskrav' table (with Karakterregel and 'Godkjent – ikke godkjent' rows) is placed in assessment, then the details of the same arbeidskrav are repeated in coursework_requirements: coursework appears in both sections, and assessment carries tabular noise and the UiT admin link. Pre-pass flag 'leak->teaching_methods' on LER-1510 is a false alarm (the fremlegg text is correct assessment).
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The 'Eksamen' block includes the 'Obligatoriske arbeidskrav' sub-table before 'Mer info om ...' sub-headings; no cut at the line 'Obligatoriske arbeidskrav'.
findings.suggested_fix: Cut the Eksamen block at the line 'Obligatoriske arbeidskrav' (route that table to coursework_requirements or drop it as duplicate of 'Mer info om arbeidskrav') and strip the 'Alt du trenger å vite ... samleside om eksamen' line.

findings.evidence: For emner som starter om høsten, vil pensumliste foreligge 15. juni. For emner som starter om våren, vil pensumliste foreligge 15. desember.
findings.description: reading_list holds only generic boilerplate or a pointer ('Du kan se og få tilgang til deler av pensum via Leganto', 'Pensum er på omlag 1000 sider...') with no actual titles. The pre-pass 'boilerplate' flag is real but the content is genuinely absent from the source; the problem is that these rows look like reading lists.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Source pages contain no reading list; the extractor emits the pointer text as a row.
findings.suggested_fix: Add the 'pensumliste foreligge 15. juni/desember' and 'via Leganto' / 'Pensumliste for X' sentences to the boilerplate-strip list in .clean_sections() so such rows become empty and are not emitted.

findings.evidence: Emnet evalueres muntlig eller skriftlig minimum en gang hvert tredje år.
findings.description: teaching_methods includes course evaluation/quality assurance sentences, the practice cross-reference and the unmapped sub-section 'Undervisnings- og eksamensspråk' with its language statement. Minor admin noise (flag 'boilerplate' is real but low impact).
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: 'Undervisnings- og eksamensspråk' (sub) and 'Kvalitetssikring' are unmapped and so appended to the previous section.
findings.suggested_fix: Map 'Undervisnings- og eksamensspråk' and 'Kvalitetssikring (av emnet)' to .drop and strip 'For nærmere informasjon om praksis, se egen praksisplan.' as boilerplate.
